title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Payments for Economic and Technological Development) (No. 2) Notification 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Payments for Economic and Technological Development) (No. 2) Notification 2011.

2. There shall be exempt from tax the royalties payable by Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd to the International Olympic Committee on or before 30th July 2011 for the —
(a)rights granted by the International Olympic Committee under the International Distribution Agreement dated 5th August 2010; and
(b)rights granted under the Merchandise License Agreement dated 23rd June 2010,
in respect of the 1st Summer Youth Olympic Games held in Singapore from 14th August 2010 to 26th August 2010.
